description: Generated protobuf Go code defining API messages and service for DRA resource management in Kubernetes, including request/response types for resource preparation and unpreparation, and resource claim definitions.

classes.name: NodePrepareResourcesRequest
classes.description: Request message for preparing resources on a node, containing a list of resource claims.

classes.name: NodePrepareResourcesResponse
classes.description: Response message for resource preparation, containing a map of claim UIDs to their preparation status.

classes.name: NodePrepareResourceResponse
classes.description: Details of a single resource claim preparation result, including devices and error info.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a device associated with a resource claim, including pool, device name, and CDI IDs.

classes.name: NodeUnprepareResourcesRequest
classes.description: Request message for unpreparing resources, containing resource claims.

classes.name: NodeUnprepareResourcesResponse
classes.description: Response for unpreparing resources, with status per claim.

classes.name: NodeUnprepareResourceResponse
classes.description: Status of unpreparing a specific resource claim, including error info.

classes.name: Claim
classes.description: Represents a resource claim with namespace, UID, and name.
